note: Murray County adopted a zoning ordinance (2019) with a County Zoning Map, and the City of Sulphur publishes its zoning map as a static PDF (27120_ZONING.pdf). Neither is a queryable polygon service. The OU CSA Murray County warehouse holds only transportation, legislative, municipal and hydrology layers (no zoning). Searches of ArcGIS Online/Hub and the state clearinghouse found no Murray County or Sulphur zoning FeatureServer. The only zoning_districts service found (services.arcgis.com/lQySeXwbBg53XWDi) is Tempe, Arizona data and does not cover Murray County (empty at the sample point).
